data.explanation: Your health insurance covered the fixed-rate part of your new hearing aids, and this invoice is for your own remaining share: €1,380 for the agreed extra cost of the devices (Mehrkostenvereinbarung) plus the statutory €20 co-payment (gesetzliche Zuzahlung). Pay the full €1,400 to the provider's account by the deadline shown. The letter says installment payments (Ratenzahlung) can be arranged if you contact them in advance. No specific consequence for late payment is mentioned, but it's best to reach out to the provider if you can't pay on time.
